verdict.rationale: Luma offers a first-party REST API with Python/JS/TS SDKs and API keys, so generation can be driven programmatically without the browser UI. Nothing documents a CLI, CI integration guidance or a non-billing test path, and the FAQ says there is no sandbox or staging environment, so CI runs consume paid production quota. missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline integration docs, sandbox or test environment, independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Luma API: Two endpoints, Python/JS/TS SDKs, credit-based pricing, production-grade from day one
Dream Machine API let's developers use image and video generation capabilities.
There is no staging or sandbox environment. Use a test key and small generations to experiment.
